replies.body:

replies.body:
Your results

6 out of a possible 10. Not terrible, but not exactly impressive either. You understand the basics of Canada but you could do with a bit more practice. Don’t worry, it’s nothing a quick bit of Wikipedia work won’t fix.
BTW, I am British xD
